itens.titulo: Chevron (CVX) Q3 Earnings Spotlight Strong Cash Flow And Flat Production
itens.descricao: Chevron (CVX) Q3 Earnings Spotlight Strong Cash Flow And Flat Production Yahoo Finance
trechos: C Chevron came into this Q3 2026 earnings print with the stock almost flat on the day, slipping just 0.15% to US$212.61, after a solid 90 day run.
That muted move sits awkwardly against the sheer size of the quarter just reported, with US$65.6b in revenue and US$9.9b in net income.

This set of numbers supports that view through earnings power more than share price reaction, which leaves investors weighing whether a quiet tape really captures what a US$5.07 per share quarter means for a mature oil major.

Adjusted earnings of US$10.4b and free cash flow of US$14.2b backed that cash story, while Venezuela and early Project Kilby progress begin to validate the long duration volume and power angle.

itens.titulo: Intel Stock’s (INTC) Deep Sell-Off Shows Signs of an Overreaction
itens.descricao: Intel Stock’s (INTC) Deep Sell-Off Shows Signs of an Overreaction Yahoo Finance
trechos: In late October, shares cratered nearly 30% in a single session after the company issued disappointing fourth-quarter guidance.
Despite the weak guidance, Intel delivered a solid third quarter, with 78% growth in its data center segment and significant improvements in manufacturing efficiency.
Still, I see a buying opportunity after the sell-off, at the current price of $52.25.
Projected 2028 adjusted earnings per share (EPS) of $2.99 valued at a five-year average forward P/E of 27x supports an $80.73 price target, implying potential upside of 55%.
After it released its third-quarter results on October 29, the semiconductor giant's shares plunged a staggering 28.6% in a single trading session on October 30.
While Wall Street analysts projected Q4 revenue of about $17 billion, Intel's management guided to just $15 billion to $16 billion.
Meanwhile, adjusted EPS guidance of $0.25 came in well below Wall Street's expectations of $0.44.
As if that weren't bad enough, management warned of production constraints, prolonged weakness in the PC market, and difficulties generating FCF in 2026.

itens.titulo: Ações da Sabesp (SBSP3) sobem 7% após balanço: o que agradou no 3º tri?
itens.descricao: Ações da Sabesp (SBSP3) sobem 7% após balanço: o que agradou no 3º tri? InfoMoney
trechos: Publicidade A Sabesp (SBSP3) reportou lucro líquido ajustado de R$ 1,107 bilhão no terceiro trimestre deste ano, em dados divulgados na noite desta quinta-feira (5).
O resultado representa uma queda de 13,8% em comparação com o mesmo período em 2025.
Os papéis da companhia subiram 6,99%, a R$ 26,78.

O lucro antes de juros, impostos, depreciações e amortizações (Ebitda, na sigla em inglês) ajustado da companhia encerrou o período a R$ 3,64 bilhões, um crescimento de 14% em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado.
Os analistas explicam que esse efeito foi amplamente compensado pelos custos, que ficaram aproximadamente R$ 110 milhões abaixo da previsão já otimista do BBA.
Ao final do terceiro trimestre, as despesas com pessoal e serviços apresentaram queda de 9% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior.
O Goldman Sachs destaca que esse desempenho ocorreu apesar dos cerca de R$ 110 milhões gastos em iniciativas do plano comercial implementadas durante o trimestre, do lado das despesas.
Ao final do terceiro trimestre, os investimentos alcançaram R$ 4,5 bilhões, um alta de 21% em relação ao trimestre anterior.

itens.titulo: The Weekly Spread: What Shaped US Treasury Yields And The Dollar This Week
itens.descricao: The Weekly Spread: What Shaped US Treasury Yields And The Dollar This Week Yahoo Finance
trechos: - A 6.4% plunge in the Nasdaq 100 and a 12% crash in semiconductor shares (SOXX) on Thursday accelerated a rotation out of equities and into fixed income.

- The yield curve, or the spread between 10-year and two-year Treasury yields, inched higher, as two-year yields dropped faster than the benchmark 10-year as traders scaled back wagers on aggressive rate hikes.
Yields across all tenors plummeted by at least four to twelve basis points, with the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield sliding to 4.85%.
The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield remained below the 5.00% threshold for the second straight week.
Treasury yield remained largely unchanged at 5.31% as on Nov.
2-year yield ticked marginally higher by 3 basis points to 0.36% in the week.
The iShares 20+ Year Treasury ETF (TLT) is on track to end its fifth straight week higher, while the shorter-duration iShares 1-3 year ETF (SHY) eased slightly so far this week.
Volumes in Treasury futures spiked roughly 40% above 20-day moving averages on Thursday as institutional portfolios scrambled for duration, according to Bloomberg data.
